1) bulk_discount_percent returns wrong values for quantities 10-49 (should be 5, returns 0). 2) parse_coupon fails on lowercase codes – implementation is case‑sensitive. 3) Cart.items() returns only quantity instead of (price, quantity). 4) Cart.remove_item raises ValueError for quantity >0 when item exists – should allow removal. 5) Cart.total with coupon rejects lowercase coupon code.
All these are mismatches between spec and implementation.
